title: Grateful Dead Live at Harpur College on 1970-05-02
lineage: cassette > Yamaha KX-W282 > Monster digital cable > Yamaha RX-530 > Monster digital cable > JVC XL-R5000 > CDR > EAC (offsets set) > CDWav > Flac (level 8)

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard out‑take from DP 8 with stellar performances (Other One, Viola Lee Blues, Cold Rain & Snow) despite occasional tuning hiccups.
ai_review.review: The recording is a remastered soundboard source that generally sounds clear and benefits from a modest EQ boost; listeners note occasional mono electric sections and brief tuning issues. Musically the show shines – fans rave about an electrifying Other One, a favorite Viola Lee Blues, and a beloved Cold Rain & Snow that, even when out of tune, adds character to the set.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars and praise the performance; recording is described as good with minor quirks, leading to a strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear remastered soundboard, but listeners recommend EQ adjustments. Electric portion is in mono; occasional out‑of‑tune moments and SRS WOW distortion warnings are noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set (stereo) flows into a mono‑recorded electric set; the show is praised for its energy and seamless transitions, with highlights placed between Good Lovin' and Man's World.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Tuning issues noted on Cold Rain & Snow (possible Gibson SG neck problem), but his improvisational work on Other One and other jams is celebrated.
band_member_comments.Keys: Electric set appears in mono, likely due to mixing choices by Bob Matthews; no specific keyboard performance comments.
